headline.answer: Edit sections.header.headline in nutrition/fixture.json. The pictured example replaces “FUEL WELL. LIVE WELL.” with your new headline.

artwork.answer: Replace nutrition/assets/web/leaf_glow.png with a transparent PNG of roughly 2:3 proportions. Alternatively, register a new ID in PNG_IDS in source/nutrition.mjs and update hero.illustrationId.

export.answer: The pictured route starts with runCLI in source/render.mjs. source/nutrition.mjs validates the fixture and 1000×1000 budget, then buildScene merges copy, font, and pinned PNGs. renderSatori builds SVG with a hero drop shadow and shrinks overflowing text. @resvg/resvg-js rasterizes the fitted SVG into PNG bytes. Publishing stages render.png, result.json, and digests, then swaps manifest.json. This explicitly describes SVG rasterization; no browser screenshot is shown. Whether the printed command actually runs cannot be determined from the picture.
